title: calepina irregularis
intro: Calepina irregularis, commonly known as Calepina, is a perennial flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion, while its therapeutic actions include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant effects. The bioactive constituents of Calepina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects and mechanisms of Calepina's bioactive constituents.
